blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Defending champion San Beda clinched the top seed in Group A after defeating College of St. Benilde, 82-69, to end the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball elimination round on Tuesday at San Juan Arena. Rookie Andrei Ugaddan led San Beda’s domination of the Blazers with 18 points, five rebounds, a steal and a block. “I don’t just stay ready, I also follow whatever it is that my teammates and coaches need of me,” Ugaddan said.
